1.c_content: 欢迎来到修真世界！接下来将引导你学习本游戏的基础操作，在这个节目中点击下方的分类按钮，比如说职业。
1.e_content: Welcome to the world of practice be god! Next, will guide you to learn the basic operation of this game. In this program, click the category button below, such as occupation.

3.c_content: 职业分类中会有很多种职业，这里显示的是职业经验，本游戏内点击蓝色字体会显示更多详情，然后点击空白处即取消。
3.e_content: There are many occupations in the occupation category. The occupation experience is displayed here. Clicking on the blue font in this game will display more details, and then clicking on the blank space will cancel it.

5.c_content: 主界面内的分类有很多种哦，道友可以一个个点击进去看看，接下来选择你要进行的行动吧！
5.e_content: There are many categories in the main interface, you can click into them one by one, and then choose the action you want to take!

6.c_content: 在这个界面中可以选择不同的行动类型，因为是刚开始游戏，所以选择低阶职业。
6.e_content: In this interface, you can choose different types of actions, because you just started the game, so choose a low-level occupation.

7.c_content: 不同的职业要求不同，详情可以点击职业名称显示详情，现在先选择【农夫】这个职业。
7.e_content: Different occupations have different requirements. For details, you can click on the occupation name to display the details. Now first select the occupation [Farmer].

8.tag: 人物弹窗按钮_选择行动
8.c_content: 在这里还可以关注相关行动，这样就可以在【关注行动】中直接选择了，现在先选择该行动。
8.e_content: Here you can also follow related actions, so you can directly select the action in [Follow Action], and now select the action first.

9.c_content: 选择行动成功后，返回到主界面，在点击下方的进行按钮即可开始游戏！(本教程已结束)
9.e_content: After the selected action is successful, return to the main interface and click the proceed button below to start the game! (This tutorial has ended)
